messages:
Rae: Quick idea  Saturday BYOC + "controller clinic"? People bring weird pads, we test, swap parts, and then a chill LAN after. TV + tables free at 6pm.
Omar: Down. I have a busted pro controller with drift that I never fixed. Can someone bring tri-wing and torx?
Jules: Ill bring a small soldering kit and some spare analog sticks. Also a roll of painters tape for labeling.
Rae: Perfect. Low pressure: clinic first for ~45 mins, then games (rocket league, smash, speedruns).
Tess: I can bring a PS2-to-HDMI upscaler if anyone wants retro practice. Also earplugs for loud sessions.
Omar: Can we do a pickup/drop box for controllers so people can try others? Label with initials.
FixIt Bot: Tool checkout logged: soldering kit (Jules), tri-wing set (Jules), HDMI upscaler (Tess). Return due by Mon 9am.
Rae: Food: tacos and chips? Any allergies? Prefer to avoid sesame.
Jules: Im vegetarian, but tacos are fine.
Tess: RSVP reactions: :joystick: bringing controller, :wrench: bringing tools, :taco: bringing food.
Omar: :joystick: :wrench:
Jules: :wrench: :taco:
Rae: Ill post a short signup with slots for clinic repairs (15 min each) and a quick map of the lounge power outlets. See yall Saturday!"
